column2: Lilmoth Dock lies north-east of here. It is a short walk. The walled part of Lilmoth lies north-north-west, a little further on. Hereguard Plantation lies west-north-west, further still. Bretons hold it.
The three dead Dunmer at the east end of Lilmoth Dock still carry their weapons and purses. It is a short walk north-east of here.
Four barrels stand about thirty paces west of the village. They hold food, and one holds common ingredients.
Three dead Dunmer lie unburied at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a short walk north-east of here. One is a man and two are women.
I keep the south stall in this village. I haggle harder than my neighbour does. I also hear what travellers say, and I pass it on.
